plain: Willingness to allow beliefs, especially religious ones, that differ from the official one

webster.text: The act of tolerating; the allowance of that which is not wholly approved; appropriately, the allowance of religious opinions and modes of worship in a state, when contrary to or different from those of the established church or belief.

example.quote: All that their most abject compliances could obtain from him was a toleration of the exercise of their laws.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 18 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 7, 1787
